sentences.en: The inescapable conclusion is that Senator Jackson has abandoned his constituents for corporate lobbyists.
sentences.zh: 不可避免的结论是，参议员杰克逊已经抛弃了他的选民，转而支持企业说客。
到了这个地步，已是无可避免。

sentences.en: Tom ended up in an inescapable situation.
sentences.zh: 汤姆最终陷入了无法摆脱的局面。

senses.zh: 不可避免的，逃避不了的,不可推卸
